title: Portugal Spain Art Culture 12 Day Itinerary
tagline: 12-Day Art, Culture & Culinary Journey: Portugal & Spain
summary: A 12-day art, culture and culinary journey from Lisbon to Madrid: tile art and fado in Lisbon, Sintra and the Atlantic coast, architecture and flamenco in Seville, the Alhambra in Granada, then Toledo and a culinary finale in Madrid.

sections.title: 12-Day Art, Culture & Culinary Journey: Portugal & Spain
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
12-Day Art, Culture & Culinary Journey: Portugal & Spain

Begin your journey with an overnight flight to Lisbon, Portugal. Arrive in Lisbon and settle into your accommodations. Meet your English-speaking tour escort and enjoy free time to explore the city’s inviting streets, historic neighborhoods and lively squares. Evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 1 - Depart for Portugal
sections.html: Begin your journey with an overnight flight to Lisbon, Portugal.

sections.title: Day 2 - Welcome to Lisbon
sections.html:
Arrive in Lisbon and settle in

Arrive in Lisbon and settle into your accommodations. Meet your English-speaking tour escort and enjoy free time to explore the city’s inviting streets, historic neighborhoods and lively squares. Evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 3 - Lisbon: Flavors & Traditions
sections.html:
Guided sightseeing experience in Lisbon

Discover Lisbon on a guided sightseeing experience combining walking and coach touring.

Portuguese specialties tasting

Sample Portuguese specialties along the way, with tastings inspired by local pastries, codfish, cheeses, tapas and regional beverages.

Evening at leisure

Enjoy the evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 4 - Lisbon: Tile Art & Fado
sections.html:
Portuguese tile-painting workshop

Take part in a hands-on Portuguese tile-painting workshop, exploring the distinctive azulejo tradition.

Portuguese dinner with live Fado performance

In the evening, enjoy a Portuguese dinner accompanied by a live Fado performance.

sections.title: Day 5 - Sintra & the Atlantic Coast
sections.html:
Guided visit to Sintra and Pena Palace

Travel by private coach to picturesque Sintra for a guided visit, including the colorful Pena Palace.

Scenic stop at Cabo da Roca and Atlantic shoreline

Continue along the coast, with a scenic stop at Cabo da Roca and the dramatic Atlantic shoreline, before returning to Lisbon.

Evening at leisure

Evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 6 - Lisbon to Seville
sections.html:
Journey across the Iberian Peninsula toward Seville

Journey across the Iberian Peninsula toward Seville. En route, enjoy a special multi-course lunch and a winery or cellar visit with tastings. Arrive in Seville and take an introductory stroll with your tour escort. Evening at leisure.
